examples.name: Sample — a clerk's stamps over a filing header
paragraphs: The boxed FILED is stamped over the header's own FILED:, and Index #: E2026004417 over the header's INDEX NO. E2026004417. The two stamps become markers, each first at its overlap; the header's own lines stay text.

snippets.text:
[stamp: FILED]

FILED: HALVERSTON COUNTY CLERK 03/14/2026 11:05 AM
[stamp: Index #: E2026004417]
INDEX NO. E2026004417
